name: sit_ground_dazed_hold
text: Remain seated on the ground with bent knees, torso slumped forward and one hand resting on a sore knee, the other supporting at the side. Subtle breathing and tiny hand motion only, stay seated.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 坐地屈膝前倾，左手停在膝腿处，右手支在身侧的保持循环；手部平放朝向约束将明显手指穿地改至最低约-0.6厘米。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
